title: Hearty Broiled Middle Eastern Beef Shin Tagine
description: A sweet and savory one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring tender beef shin, broiled to perfection and served with a side of warm spices and dried fruits, this recipe is tamasic-friendly and prepared on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon.
Add the beef shin pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Arrange the beef shin pieces on a wooden board in a single layer.
Broil the beef shin for 10 minutes on each side, or until browned.
While the beef is broiling, heat the onion and prunes in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the broiled beef shin to the Dutch oven and stir to combine with the onion and prunes.
Drizzle the honey over the top of the beef shin and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and simmer the tagine over low heat for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
